tagline: Designing polymer nanocomposites that shield electronics, manage heat and resist corrosion, and turning waste into engineering materials.
about: Dr Kulthe heads the Department of Metallurgy and Materials Engineering at COEP Technological University, where she has taught since October 2005, rising from Lecturer to Assistant Professor and Head of Department. She began her career with a year of industrial research at TRDDC, Pune.

She holds a B.E. from VNIT Nagpur, an M.E. from COEP and a Ph.D. from Savitribai Phule Pune University. Her work is funded by ANRF, AICTE, UGC and industry, and she received the Alumni Distinguished Faculty Fellow Award (2023–25).
